1|# custom recipe: mbedtls in-tree fuzz programs (programs/fuzz) as OSS-Fuzz builds them, plus the
2|# step OSS-Fuzz's build.sh of that period lacked: generated sources (error.c, version_features.c,
3|# query_config.c, ...) were removed from git in 2021-05 and CMake could not yet regenerate them,
4|# so they are produced with the project's own `make generated_files` first. The boringssl/openssl
5|# corpora that the Dockerfile cloned (openssl/boringssl, mostly DER keys and certificates) are not
6|# available offline; as a stand-in the project's own DER test files are added to the PEM/key seeds.
7|cd $SRC/mbedtls
8|perl scripts/config.pl set MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_TIME_ALT || python3 scripts/config.py set MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_TIME_ALT
9|make generated_files >/dev/null 2>&1 || { make -C library generated_files; make -C programs generated_files; }
10|mkdir -p build && cd build
11|cmake .. -DENABLE_TESTING=Off -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=$CC -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=$CXX >/dev/null
12|make -k -j2 -C programs/fuzz || make -k -j2
13|cp programs/fuzz/fuzz_* $OUT/ 2>/dev/null
14|cd ../programs
15|zip -q -r $OUT/fuzz_privkey_seed_corpus.zip ../tests/data_files/*.key ../tests/data_files/*.pem ../tests/data_files/*.der
16|zip -q -r $OUT/fuzz_pubkey_seed_corpus.zip ../tests/data_files/*.pub ../tests/data_files/*.pubkey
17|zip -q -r $OUT/fuzz_x509crt_seed_corpus.zip ../tests/data_files/*.crt ../tests/data_files/*.der
18|for d in client server dtlsclient dtlsserver; do [ -d fuzz/corpuses/$d ] && zip -q -r $OUT/fuzz_${d}_seed_corpus.zip fuzz/corpuses/$d; done
19|cp fuzz/*.options $OUT/ 2>/dev/null

2|API changes
3|   * For all functions that take a random number generator (RNG) as a
4|     parameter, this parameter is now mandatory (that is, NULL is not an
5|     acceptable value). Functions which previously accepted NULL and now

9|     functions in ECP.

11|     mbedtls_ecp_check_pub_priv(), mbedtls_pk_check_pair(),
12|     mbedtls_pk_parse_key(), mbedtls_pk_parse_keyfile().
13|Removals
14|   * The configuration option MBEDTLS_ECP_NO_INTERNAL_RNG has been removed as
15|     it no longer had any effect.

2|The RNG parameter is now mandatory for all functions that accept one
3|--------------------------------------------------------------------
4|
5|This change affects all users who called a function accepting a `f_rng`
6|parameter with `NULL` as the value of this argument; this is no longer
7|supported.

9|The changed functions are: the X.509 CRT and CSR writing functions; the PK and
10|RSA sign and decrypt functions; `mbedtls_rsa_private()`; the functions in DHM
11|and ECDH that compute the shared secret; the scalar multiplication functions in
12|ECP.
13|
14|You now need to pass a properly seeded, cryptographically secure RNG to all
15|functions that accept a `f_rng` parameter. It is of course still possible to
16|pass `NULL` as the context pointer `p_rng` if your RNG function doesn't need a
17|context.
18|
19|Alternative implementations of a module (enabled with the `MBEDTLS_module_ALT`
20|configuration options) may have their own internal and are free to ignore the
21|`f_rng` argument but must allow users to pass one anyway.
22|
23|Some functions gained an RNG parameter
24|--------------------------------------
25|
26|This affects users of the following functions: `mbedtls_ecp_check_pub_priv()`,
27|`mbedtls_pk_check_pair()`, `mbedtls_pk_parse_key()`, and
28|`mbedtls_pk_parse_keyfile()`.
29|
30|You now need to pass a properly seeded, cryptographically secure RNG when
31|calling these functions. It is used for blinding, a counter-measure against
32|side-channel attacks.
33|
34|The configuration option `MBEDTLS_ECP_NO_INTERNAL_RNG` was removed
35|------------------------------------------------------------------
36|
37|This doesn't affect users of the default configuration; it only affects people
38|who were explicitly setting this option.
39|
40|This was a trade-off between code size and counter-measures; it is no longer
41|relevant as the counter-measure is now always on at no cost in code size.

2072|    w = grp->nbits >= 384 ? 5 : 4;

2077|     * and the memory cost too.

2081|

2086|     *

2088|     * static comb table, because the size of static comb table is fixed when

706|                                   const unsigned char *key,
707|                                   size_t keylen )
708|{
709|    int ret, version;
710|    size_t len;
711|    unsigned char *p, *end;
712|
713|    mbedtls_mpi T;
714|    mbedtls_mpi_init( &T );
715|
716|    p = (unsigned char *) key;
717|    end = p + keylen;
718|
719|    /*
720|     * This function parses the RSAPrivateKey (PKCS#1)
721|     *
722|     *  RSAPrivateKey ::= SEQUENCE {
723|     *      version           Version,
724|     *      modulus           INTEGER,  -- n
725|     *      publicExponent    INTEGER,  -- e
726|     *      privateExponent   INTEGER,  -- d
727|     *      prime1            INTEGER,  -- p
728|     *      prime2            INTEGER,  -- q
729|     *      exponent1         INTEGER,  -- d mod (p-1)
730|     *      exponent2         INTEGER,  -- d mod (q-1)
731|     *      coefficient       INTEGER,  -- (inverse of q) mod p
732|     *      otherPrimeInfos   OtherPrimeInfos OPTIONAL
733|     *  }
734|     */
735|    if( ( ret = mbedtls_asn1_get_tag( &p, end, &len,
736|            MBEDTLS_ASN1_CONSTRUCTED | MBEDTLS_ASN1_SEQUENCE ) ) != 0 )
737|    {
738|        return( MBEDTLS_ERROR_ADD( MBEDTLS_ERR_PK_KEY_INVALID_FORMAT, ret ) );
739|    }
740|
741|    end = p + len;
742|

744|    {
745|        return( MBEDTLS_ERROR_ADD( MBEDTLS_ERR_PK_KEY_INVALID_FORMAT, ret ) );
